q1_issues.issue: The compound-kind decomposition atoms (Inheritance power_plant plant) and (Inheritance coal_power_plant power_plant) are kept inside the attitude seal, but definitional decomposition atoms of compounds P mentions must project out of an attitude seal to top level, so these genus links are never actually asserted.
"especially coal" becomes a bare SubsetOf coal-plant subgroup, so the scalar emphasis is silently dropped and the symbol coal_power_plant is coined from the elliptical bare noun "coal".
The non-specific mass object "power" is given a witness sk_power_1 with its own Member atom, where a non-specific / kind-level object should take the bare class symbol.

q2_gaps: Specificational nominal attitude "X's hope is that P" — the attitude sections cover attitude verbs with that-complements, not a copular clause whose subject is an attitude noun taking the that-clause as its predicate.

Attributive / elided-standard comparatives ("older power plants", "more power", "more cheaply") have no licensed form, so the entire comparative point of the sentence is dropped; the instruction set registers this as drop-and-record-the-gap.
Scalar focus "especially" is not among the licensed focus particles (only / even / also / cleft), so the emphasis on coal has no carrier.
notes: The non-factive routing is right (nothing from P is predicated at top level, the definite "the efficiency" projects) and "the Bush administration" correctly takes head typing plus Possession to the named entity. What survives of P is materially weaker than the sentence, because all three comparatives are unencodable.
